query: What is the maximum supported file upload size?
supporting_fact: The maximum file size is 25 MiB.

query: How many tokens are used for fixed-size chunks and overlap?
supporting_fact: Fixed-size chunking uses 512 tokens with 64-token overlap.

query: What happens to embeddings when no provider is configured?
supporting_fact: Chunks can be persisted without vector embeddings and embedding_count reports the count.

query: Which search methods are combined before reranking?
supporting_fact: Dense vector search and sparse PostgreSQL full-text search plus optional metadata retrieval are fused with weighted RRF.

query: Which cross-encoder reranker does NeuroFlow use?
How is MRR calculated when no relevant chunk is retrieved?
supporting_fact: The query contributes zero to reciprocal rank when no relevant chunk is retrieved.

query: Why must benchmark labels use chunk UUIDs instead of document UUIDs?
supporting_fact: Retrieval evaluation compares returned chunk IDs with relevant_chunk_ids.
